# Java translated to Rust

Translated 507 of 14428 methods (1 more is done another way in Horizon) and 506 of 923 static fields to Rust (1 of those call the game, through Horizon's helpers); 1 of 1 Fabric event handlers. It's in `runtime.rs`, under `pub mod java`; code that calls the game is in `game_side.rs`.

Each method is translated whole or not at all. A method that can't be (it uses Minecraft, a lambda, null...) is left out with its reason, and so is every method that calls it.

## Why methods were left out

| Cause | Methods | For example |
|---|---|---|
| Calls or uses other code that isn't translated | 9752 | `JeiFluidIngredient.JeiFluidIngredient(2)`: its class isn't translated (another class has the same name, in a different package) |
| Other Java this translator doesn't handle yet | 3925 | `IJeiFluidIngredient.getFluidVariant(0)`: it has no body |
| Uses Minecraft classes (needs Horizon's game API) | 130 | `JeiChatItemLinkHover.getHoveredStyle(3)`: it uses Minecraft's `Style` |
| Uses other libraries | 42 | `DebugConfig.create(1)`: it uses `IConfigSchemaBuilder` (net.mezzdev.config.api.schema.builder) |
| Uses Java collections other than List (Map, Set...) | 27 | `LegacyConfigPaths.get(3)`: it uses `UUID` (java.util) |
| Shares one object between names (Java references) | 13 | `JsonArrayWriter.add(1)`: it changes an object through a second name |
| Uses null | 10 | `LegacyServerConfigMigration.LegacyServerConfigMigration(3)`: a Path with no value (null in Java) |
| Uses inheritance (extends, implements, instanceof) | 5 | `WordlistLoader.getBufferedReader(1)`: `instanceof` |
| Calls the game where Horizon has no helper yet | 4 | `IJeiKeyMappingInternal.isMouseButtonDown(2)`: it uses Minecraft's Minecraft.mouseHandler (no Horizon helper for it yet) |
| Uses Fabric API | 4 | `JeiChatEventHandler.register(0)`: it uses Fabric's `ClientReceiveMessageEvents`.ALLOW_CHAT |
| Uses try/catch | 3 | `ModHelper.readAllBytes(1)`: a try/catch (IOException, RuntimeException) |
| Uses files (java.nio / java.io) | 2 | `BitUtil.getNativeByteOrder(0)`: it uses `ByteOrder` (java.nio) |
| Uses translated text (Component.translatable) | 2 | `ConfigManagerAdapter.getLocalizedName(1)`: a translated text with a computed key |
| Done another way in Horizon | 1 | `JustEnoughItemsClient.onInitializeClient(0)`: done another way in Horizon: it runs as `on_init`, from Horizon's init hook |
| Uses JOML maths (vectors, matrices) | 1 | `RecipeTransferButtonController.runWithRestoredPose(2)`: it uses `Matrix3x2fStack` (org.joml) |

## Fabric event handlers

| Handler | Hook | Result |
|---|---|---|
| mezz/jei/fabric/JustEnoughItems.java:24 | `init` | `on_init`, called from the hook, without: the local `var4`: it uses IServerConfig, which isn't translated (it's an interface); the call to `ServerNetworkHandler.registerServerPacketHandlers(..)`: it calls ServerNetworkHandler.registerServerPacketHandlers, which isn't translated; the local `var10000`: it uses Minecraft's `Registry`; the local `var10001`: it uses Minecraft's `Registry`; the call to `RecipeSerializers.register(..)`: it calls RecipeSerializers.register, which isn't translated; the local `var7`: unknown name `var10000`; a `while` loop: unknown name `var7` |
